note: The one record every colour, space and duration on the site comes from. tools/tokens.mjs renders it to site/src/styles/tokens.css and computes every contrast ratio, tools/check_tokens.mjs fails CI when the rendered file is stale, when a text pair falls under 4.5 to 1, or when a component writes a hex, a millisecond or a curve by hand. Nothing here is typed twice.

roles.ink: text, the H1, rules on plates
roles.muted: secondary text, captions, nav at rest, spec rail labels
roles.rule: 1px hairlines only, never text, about 1.3 to 1 on paper
roles.field: code blocks, the spec sheet, the filmstrip track, a tone rather than a card
roles.marker: the one accent: frame numbers, the active chapter, hover, focus, the record dot
roles.blueprint: build chapters only: graph strokes, histogram bars, code links
roles.plate: every media band in both themes, so the work reads at cinema contrast whatever the page does

motion.note: The work is the motion and the interface stays still. Two columns: the value, and what it becomes under reduced motion, which is a decision per movement rather than a switch that zeroes everything. A colour change and an opacity fade are not movement.

tokens.name: t-quick
tokens.used_by: row hover tint, hover intent timer
tokens.why: A colour change is not movement.

tokens.name: t-fade
tokens.why: Opacity is not movement, and a hard cut between stills is worse for vestibular readers than a short fade.

tokens.name: t-slide
tokens.why: Position change becomes a cut, same end state.

tokens.name: t-blink
tokens.used_by: the record dot while a clip plays
tokens.why: Becomes a steady dot, and a mono PLAYING label sits beside it so the blink is never the only signal.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.why: Nothing moves under reduce, so the curve is moot and linear says so.
